description: Co-located evaluation benchmark for agent-security security audit skill

test_cases.name: Single Skill Security Audit Verification
test_cases.description: Ensures agent-security performs OWASP vulnerability scanning, input validation reviews, and secret protection checks.
test_cases.prompt: Audit our object storage share adapter for OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities.

test_cases.name: SonarQube findings triage
test_cases.description: Ensures SonarQube issue passes use sonarqube-findings, the sonar MCP profile, and skip GitHub Actions SHA pins.
test_cases.prompt: Fix SonarQube issues and security hotspots in this repo.

test_cases.name: Dependabot stays a vendor PR
test_cases.description: Ensures Dependabot and CodeQL stay on vendor PRs via quality-loops: hygiene without a lockfile rewrite, alert-number keys, and comments on noisy findings.
test_cases.prompt: A Dependabot PR is open. Keep it merge-ready. Do not rewrite the lockfile. Key a high alert to that alert number. Comment why on noisy findings and do not churn code.

test_cases.name: Scout Sonar policy skip files no ticket
test_cases.description: Ensures a scheduled scout that hits a Sonar policy skip including Actions tags skips with no NOSONAR and no Linear ticket via quality-loops.
test_cases.prompt: Scheduled scout: Sonar policy skip for Actions tags. Skip, no NOSONAR, no ticket.

test_cases.name: Scout files a typed Sonar ticket after restore
test_cases.description: Ensures a Sonar fix finding files one typed ticket after restore wk mcp default and does not open a PR or file while the sonar profile is on.
test_cases.prompt: File a Linear ticket from a SonarQube BUG finding after restore default. Do not open a PR.

required_patterns: Do not create issues while the sonar profile is on

test_cases.name: Work picker plays a Security ticket as a draft PR
test_cases.description: Playing a claimed Security ticket via quality-loops opens a draft PR only and runs the repo pre-commit hook before COMPLETE.
test_cases.prompt: Play the claimed Security ticket from the work picker as a draft PR. Do not merge.
